owner: FIX_STAY_ENGAGED (movement: stay engaged on purpose when the fight is worth more than falling back - COO-18; absorbs SUR-06/SUR-18/DEN-15/OFF-09)
rationale: 11e 12.04: in a Fight phase the player whose turn it is selects first, in the Fights First step and, when no Fights First unit is eligible, in Resolve Remaining Combats too - so a unit that stays engaged through its own Movement phase strikes before an enemy that did not charge (no Fights First here: Lions of the Emperor). 09.07: a unit that falls back cannot shoot, declare a charge (11.02) or start an action until the end of the turn, and 04.02: an engaged non-MONSTER/VEHICLE unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks. So falling back is not free: it throws away the fight the unit would win. U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A (5 Custodian Guard, guardian spears A5 WS2+ S7 AP-2 D2, T6 2+/4++, 215 pts) is locked with U_PROSECUTORS_A_P2 (4 x T3 3+ W1, 45 pts) off every objective: in our own Fight phase it deals 25 x 5/6 x 5/6 x 2/3 = 11.6 damage against 4 wounds - it wipes them, striking first, while they could return only 8 x 4/6 x 1/6 x 1/6 = 0.15 damage. Today the default branch of _decide_engaged_unit falls back whenever the unit is not on an objective, so it walks away. With FIX_STAY_ENGAGED the STAY-vs-LEAVE ledger prices that fight: stay = 45.0 (out-fight: 4 W x 11.25 pts/W) + 11.25 (wipe bonus, 25% of 45 pts) + 16.1 (T7-27 hold bias 1.5 x 10.75 pts/W) - 0 (strike-back, removed by striking first) = 72.4 against leave 0, so it stays engaged (REMAIN_STATIONARY). The guard against an AI that never falls back: our U_PROSECUTORS_A, locked with U_ALLARUS_CUSTODIANS_A_P2 (A5 S7 AP-2 spears against T3 W1), would take 11.6 damage against 4 wounds for 0.15 dealt: stay = 2.0 - 45.0 = -43 against leave 22.5 (T7-27 fall-back bias 2 x 11.25), so it must still fall back and end unengaged. Custodian Guard Gamma holds obj_home_1, so neither fall back can change who controls an objective; every other model is parked more than 30" away, so no shield, lock or close-quarters term is in play. Assert 1 pins the premises on the engine (engaged, off every objective, nothing else in reach); asserts 2-3 grade the decision text and the board (did not fall back, did not move, still engaged), assert 4 stops a pass by never falling back, and assert 5 requires both choices to be recorded with the right key.
